content.value: Let a Gaussian function $G ( x , \sigma ) = e ^ { - x ^ { 2 } } / 2 \sigma ^ { 2 }$ and its derivative $G ^ { \prime }$ is sampled at 5 points (14) symmetric to the origin with $\scriptstyle \Delta x = 1 , \sigma = 1$ .The sampled values of G and $G ^ { \prime }$ are used as 1D separable kernel to convolve an image in x and y direction, respectively. Find
i) The x and y directional 1D kernels; scale and round the values to integer.
iii) Note the benefits of using separable 2D kernels.
